title: Leonardo DiCaprio
extract: Leonardo Wilhelm DiCaprio is an American actor and film producer. Regarded as one of Hollywood’s defining leading men, his work spans character-driven cinema and major blockbusters across genres, exploring themes of ambition, corruption, and moral decline. He is the recipient of numerous accolades, including an Academy Award, an Actor Award, a BAFTA Award, an Emmy Award, a Silver Bear and three Golden Globes. With his starring films grossing $7 billion worldwide, he has placed eight times in annual rankings of the world's highest-paid actors.
